Name: Deltarune Dig Spot (Content Patcher)
Author: Kristherats
Description:
How to install?
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download and unzip "[CP] Deltarune Dig spot"
[*]Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
Very simple mod, still very new to modding so all bug reports or advice are greatly appreciated :)
